issues.title: Truncated Examples and OpenAPI Reference
issues.why: The module is ~117 KB and the provided context is truncated at the 120KB cap, cutting off the end of the changelog and potentially critical parts of the OpenAPI (17) and Examples (14) files if they were appended.
issues.fix: Ensure the AI coder has access to the full text of 14-endpoint-examples.md and 17-openapi.yaml in a separate context window.

issues.title: Concurrency Strategy Externalized
issues.why: AC-26 and AC-78 explicitly offload the SQLite locking/concurrency contract to spec/13. A mediocre coder without web access or cross-module context cannot resolve this dependency.
issues.fix: Inline the specific SQLite locking pragma requirements (e.g., BEGIN IMMEDIATE) and WAL mode settings into 02-database-schema.md.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'PascalCase' for JSON Values
issues.why: Locked Decision #2 mandates PascalCase for JSON values, but AC-73/74 use kebab-case strings like 'still-green' for state labels, creating a naming convention conflict.
issues.fix: Update AC-73 and §01 Glossary to use PascalCase (StillGreen, FirstFailure) for all enum-like string values.
